messages.text: Client on my book wants to hedge about 12mm EUR receivables out to Q1. Forward or do they want optionality? Looking for a quick take before I call back.

Depends on how firm the receivables are. If the invoices are locked, plain forwards. If there's slippage risk, a collar or partial hedge is cleaner. Forward points are carrying a little in their favor right now.
Ronald, is it a corporate or one of the wealth clients? Different paperwork depending on which. Also confirm they have an ISDA or whatever we need on file before we quote.
Wealth side, entity account. {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0042}} is already onboarded, docs are in. Will double check the FX addendum is signed before I show a price.
FYI EURUSD is chopping around the figure, 3m implied vol bid a touch into the afternoon. Whoever's pricing options might want to wait for the data print.
Not my product but if it's staggered monthly buckets I'd just do rolling forwards instead of one big outright. Less gap risk on the roll.
I can run a quick hedge ratio sim on 50/75/100% coverage with the current curve. Gimme 15 min. Need the expected invoice schedule though.
Roughly 4mm Nov, 4mm Dec, 4mm Jan. Client says Dec is the soft one.
Reminder from Risk: any new FX forward over 10mm notional needs a limit check before it goes into OMS. Ronald, send me the notional and tenor and I'll confirm headroom on the counterparty line.
Thanks Owen. 12mm total, tenors 1m to 3m. Will split into three tickets.
Headroom is fine on the aggregate. Just keep the three tickets tagged to the same parent so the exposure rolls up correctly.
Is anyone else seeing TradeBlotter lag on the FX tab? P&L on my forwards hasn't refreshed in a few minutes.
Yeah mine's stale too. Might just be the pricing refresh, OMS ticket entry looks normal though.
Hard refresh fixed it for me. Probably a cache thing.
Sim's done. 75% coverage on Nov/Dec and full on Jan cuts the tail the most per unit of carry cost. 100% across the board over-hedges if Dec slips. Posting the table in a sec.
Perfect, that matches the story from the client. I'll pitch 75/75/100 and offer a Dec put-spread overlay as the alternative.
Make sure the quote has the spread disclosed for them in writing. Sales credit goes on the parent ticket.
Will do. Calling the client now.
Client took 75/75/100 forwards. Done at mid plus two pips all in. Tickets are in OMS and tagged to the parent, Owen.
